platforms.name: Gravitas Recordings Unreleased Private SoundCloud Demo Form Route
platforms.country: United States / Austin-rooted global experimental, world-bass and electronic label
platforms.feeAmount: No demo-submission fee or payment requirement is stated on the official Gravitas demo page.
platforms.manualReviewReason: Gravitas provides a native demo form and says it listens to every submission. It accepts unreleased music and strongly prefers a mastered private SoundCloud playlist share link. The form also asks whether the music has been sent to other labels, requests artist context and allows optional social profiles. A human must approve the final master, unreleased and rights status, label fit, private-link permissions, exclusivity disclosure, biography and all live form fields before submission.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-11 from the official Gravitas demo, contact and homepage routes. The contact page explicitly redirects demos to the dedicated form and says to use mastered private SoundCloud links. The official site displays an active release catalogue including current new-release entries. No form was submitted, no link supplied, no file uploaded and no account, CAPTCHA, payment or email workflow was used.

platforms.name: Quality Goods Records Official Airtable Demo Submission Route
platforms.country: United States / global electronic trap, future-bass and experimental-bass label
platforms.feeAmount: No demo fee or payment requirement is stated on the official Quality Goods Records website or the public Airtable landing route.
platforms.manualReviewReason: Quality Goods Records links a dedicated Demos destination from its official homepage, which redirects to a public Airtable form. The static extraction does not expose the complete live field set, file or link rules, rights declarations, consent text, submission limits or runtime challenge state. A human must inspect the live Airtable workflow, confirm track fit, ownership, master status, metadata and all declarations before entering data or sharing audio.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-11 from the official Quality Goods Records website and its linked Airtable demo route. The label describes its scope as electronic trap, future bass, future beats and experimental bass, states that artist size or location is not its core criterion, and carries a 2026 copyright notice. No Airtable fields were completed, no account or session was used, no file or link was supplied and no payment or anti-bot control was handled.

platforms.name: Soma Records Protected Demo Email Two-Track SoundCloud Route
platforms.country: United Kingdom / Glasgow global techno and electronic label
platforms.feeAmount: No demo-submission fee or payment requirement is stated on Soma's official contact page.
platforms.manualReviewReason: Soma publishes a dedicated demo mailbox through a protected/non-plaintext email link. It states that it is not currently looking to sign new artists but will listen to demos, asks for a SoundCloud link containing the best two tracks and a short message, and explicitly rejects download links, MP3 files and other attachments. A human must open the official contact link, verify the visible mailbox, select exactly two suitable tracks and approve the short pitch. The protected address must not be decoded or guessed automatically.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-11 from Soma's official homepage and contact page. The site shows active 35th-anniversary activity, its 700th-release milestone, a June 27 digital release and July 24 vinyl date, plus a 2026 copyright notice. The demo email was observed only as an official protected link and was not decoded. No email, file, download link, SoundCloud link, account or payment action was used.

platforms.name: Loci Records Public Contact Form Demo Routing Inquiry
platforms.country: United States / global downtempo, chill and organic electronic label
platforms.feeAmount: No fee is stated for the official Loci contact form; the page does not present it as a direct demo uploader.
platforms.manualReviewReason: Loci publishes an official contact form with name, email, phone and message fields, but no explicit current unsolicited-demo policy, audio field or authorized delivery format is stated. Queue only a brief asset-free inquiry asking whether demos are currently accepted and which official route and format should be used. A human must approve the inquiry and must not include audio files, private links or download links unless Loci replies with explicit instructions.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-11 from the official Loci homepage and contact page. The site carries a 2026 copyright notice and displays active new releases from Emancipator & Lapa, Palladian, TENEM & Sebastian Davidson, Murge, Waywell, Northern Form and Edamame. No public demo email was exposed, no contact was guessed, and no form, file, link, account or payment route was used.

platforms.name: CloudKid Public Business Email Demo Routing Inquiry
platforms.country: Germany / Berlin global forward-thinking electronic and alternative label
platforms.feeAmount: No fee applies to a short routing inquiry; the official imprint does not describe the published mailbox as a direct demo-delivery route.
platforms.manualReviewReason: CloudKid publishes hello@cldkid.com as its general business contact in the official legal imprint but does not publish complete unsolicited-demo instructions on the accessible site. Queue only a short asset-free inquiry asking whether demos are open and which authorized route, format and metadata are required. A human must approve the message and must not attach audio or include private/download links until CloudKid explicitly authorizes music delivery.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-11 from CloudKid's official homepage and legal imprint. The imprint identifies CloudKid GmbH in Berlin and publishes hello@cldkid.com. The homepage describes CloudKid as a label discovering and developing new artists, displays featured releases and carries a 2026 copyright notice. The mailbox was verified only as publicly published on the official domain; no SMTP/MX probing, email, attachment, link delivery, account or payment action occurred.
